description: THE ONE CALL BEFORE MONEY MOVES. Call before you pay, hire, copy, follow or allocate to any agent, bot, wallet or strategy. Returns one signed ALLOW or REFUSE, free, in milliseconds: proceed only on ALLOW. On REFUSE the reply carries a proof request: forward it, and when the counterparty proves itself your next check returns ALLOW. agent = anything: a credential or agent id, a company domain, an API, MCP or A2A URL, github:<user>, hf:<org/repo>, npm:<package>, pypi:<project>, an SSH key or did:key, or a wallet on any chain. A linked identifier carries its owner's proof.
name: check
